questions.ask: What name should I use for you: the one that appears on screen and in my notes?
What is the business or brand called?
What is your main handle, and on which platform do you post most?
In one sentence: what do you help people with, and who are they?
What is your accent colour? (This style does not draw it: it is saved so every skill in the pack shares one profile.)
(saved with the accent colour) the plain word for it: blue, gold, lime
Which font do you use for headlines?
(found on their computer) the bold weight of the main font
(found on their computer) the regular or medium weight of the main font; used for the captions when no caption font is set
Captions in the same main font, or a different one?
(found on their computer) the caption font file or installed name; leave unset to reuse the main font
Transcribe with ElevenLabs (recommended, the most accurate word timings) or on this computer (free)?
Where should finished videos go? Next to the raw file in an '- Edit' folder is the default.
questions.default: beside the raw file, in a "<video name> - Edit" folder

questions.ask: Is your raw footage on an external drive? Which one?
Where do you keep music you are allowed to use?
Should I always ask before adding music, or add a favourite and tell you which?
Where do you keep the real things I can show on screen: client results, testimonials, screenshots?
How big should the captions be? 30 px on a 1080-wide frame is the tiny, quiet size this style is built on.
Where should the left edge of the captions sit, in pixels from the left of a 1080-wide frame? (Moved per reel to the side of the chin with the most clear space.)
How far down should the top of the captions sit, in pixels from the top of a 1920-high frame? Always above 1250.
Which kinds of image do you want above your head: metaphors and surreal art, memes, known experiments and diagrams, quote screenshots? Anything you do not want?
questions.default: a mix of metaphor and surreal art, memes people recognise, known experiments or diagrams, and quote screenshots or the person when one is named

questions.ask: Where should I look for images: Pinterest in your own logged-in Chrome (needs the Claude in Chrome extension), a web image search, only your own folders, or a mix?
questions.default: Pinterest through the Claude in Chrome extension when it is connected, otherwise the web image search script, plus the creator's own folders first

questions.ask: Besides your proof folder, are there folders of your own images I should search first (screenshots, past reels, a saved collection)? Full paths; several are fine.
Is there anything or anyone that must never be shown on screen: people, brands, topics, competitors?
Should I show you a quick 720p preview and wait for your notes before the full-quality render, or go straight to the final?
questions.default: show a preview and wait for approval before the final render
